bio.text: Nathan Johnson is a Democratic member of the Texas Senate for District 16 in Dallas County, first elected in 2018.
He is the Democratic nominee for Texas Attorney General in the November 2026 election, according to the Texas Tribune.
Johnson is an attorney at Thompson Coburn, where his Senate biography says he specializes in trial litigation and dispute resolution.
He holds a B.S. in physics from the University of Arizona and a law degree from the University of Texas.
